messages.text: When will the moon next be in Taurus?

The next time the Moon will be in Taurus is for the Full Moon on November 15, 2024, at 4:28 p.m. Eastern Time. This Full Moon aligns with Uranus, a planet associated with disruption and change, potentially bringing unexpected shifts in areas related to stability, security, and relationships. It represents a culmination point, especially in Taurus-ruled areas like finances and self-worth, encouraging a balance between stability and transformation. This alignment with Uranus can amplify the urge for liberation from outdated patterns, which may lead to significant, if challenging, realizations.

This Full Moon also forms a harmonious trine with Pluto, adding a transformative energy that encourages deep personal growth. With the Moon in Taurus—a sign that values grounding and security—this lunation offers a chance to reassess and reinforce stable foundations in preparation for the changes to come (AstroMatrix; Conscious Reminder; The Dark Pixie Astrology).
